status: Native Finance standalone customer-receipt detail, export and issue verified on desktop and mobile; the sales-invoice workspace remains partial for standalone edit/void

behavior.issue: a settled receipt payment with a posted journal and no Field ownership receives erpx_sales_document_number(company,'RC',paymentDate), an immutable snapshot_json, export_html and its SHA-256, all inside the caller's serializable transaction
behavior.snapshot: finance.customer-receipt.v1 with company/customer, date, currency, amount, payment id/version, bank reference, journal id and the ordered invoice allocations
behavior.read: returns the retained receipt, snapshot, status and SHA; the status is cancelled when the source payment is cancelled/reversed/voided and the issued copy is never rewritten
behavior.export: returns the retained export_html with x-document-sha256 and a strict CSP; the browser SHA equals the stored export_sha256
behavior.scope: Company scope by default; branch/department receipts are visible only through the original Commerce fulfillment invoice lineage
behavior.fieldExclusion: Field-owned payments return NATIVE_FINANCE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED and remain on the existing native Field receipt interface; a deferred DB trigger also enforces the native Field owner unit
behavior.authority: current Account/Holding authority, rendered-context CAS, finance.read/finance.write, module.finance.read and finance.accounting or finance.sales-posting purchase

cases: issue 201 for a settled posted payment, immutable RC-2026-000001 snapshot and export
read returns the snapshot document number, customer, amount, bank reference, journal and allocation
export HTML contains the document number, customer, invoice and received total; SHA equals the read SHA
exact replay returns the retained receipt without a second copy or receipt row
Company isolation and branch scope return no receipt without the original fulfillment lineage
HTTP issue 201, read 200 and export 200 text/html with x-document-sha256 using a real cookie/CAS/key
checks.gates: cargo clippy private-field-api, typecheck, structure, architecture, docs, catalogue (33 modules, 791 suites), rust-runtime-foundation 6/6, finance unit transport suites 4/4

persisted.commands: one finance.customer-receipt.issue command_receipt, audit_event and outbox_event per payment

browser.nativeProof: With ERPX_NATIVE_FINANCE_SALES_RECEIPT_CONFIG present, the page read and export are served by the native API; the Sales route skips the Field readback only when the Field config is absent, and Field-owned receipts still return NATIVE_FINANCE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED.

limits: The generic sales-invoice workspace remains partial: standalone invoice edit/void is still TS.

A Field-owned receipt cannot be seeded into the isolated PostgreSQL fixture because the deferred native_service_payment_write_required trigger correctly demands the native Field owner unit; the generic guard is covered by code and the DB trigger, and Field receipts remain on their existing native interface.
The browser console still logs pre-existing hydration/work-source errors; pageErrors stay 0.
The export is exercised by a normal authenticated browser navigation; the retained copy is the stored export_html, not a re-render.
